hooks.command: v=$(node -v 2>/dev/null); case "$v" in v24.[3-9]*|v24.[1-9][0-9]*|v2[5-9].*|v[3-9][0-9].*|v[1-9][0-9][0-9]*) ;; *) echo "sub-human needs Node 24.3 or newer on the PATH that Claude Code was started with, and found $([ -n "$v" ] && echo "node $v" || echo 'none (node: command not found)'). Install it (https://nodejs.org, or nvm, fnm or mise) and restart claude from a shell where node -v works." >&2; exit 2;; esac; exec node --import "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/compile-cache.js" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.ts" join

h="${SUB_HUMAN_HOME:-$HOME/.sub-human}/sessions"; s="$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"; [ -z "$s" ] || [ -e "$h/mods/$s.json" ] || [ -e "$h/by-sid/$s.json" ] || [ -e "$h/by-pid/$CLAUDE_PID.json" ] || { while IFS= read -r _; do :; done; exit 0; }; exec node --import "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/compile-cache.js" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.ts" session-end
